description: This Java source file defines the `LoanScheduleDeleteVariationCommandHandler` class, which is a command handler responsible for processing requests to delete loan schedule variations in the Fineract system. It implements the handling logic by invoking the `deleteLoanScheduleVariations` method on the `LoanScheduleWritePlatformService` when a command of type `LOAN` and action `DELETESCHEDULEEXCEPTIONS` is received.

classes.name: LoanScheduleDeleteVariationCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class annotated with Spring's @Service and Lombok's @RequiredArgsConstructor that processes loan schedule variation deletion commands.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the incoming JSON command by delegating to the LoanScheduleWritePlatformService to delete loan schedule variations based on the command's loan ID.
